service: Supervised exercise therapy (SET) for symptomatic PAD
vignette: 71-year-old man with calf claudication after walking 2 blocks; ankle-brachial index 0.62 on the right. His primary physician has documented no contraindication to exercise. At a face-to-face visit, the vascular physician responsible for his PAD treatment referred him for SET and provided counseling on cardiovascular disease and PAD risk factor reduction, including smoking cessation, lipid and blood pressure control, and diabetes management. The program is in the hospital outpatient vascular rehabilitation department: 36 treadmill-based exercise-training sessions over 12 weeks, each lasting 45 minutes, delivered by exercise physiologists trained in exercise therapy for PAD, under the direct supervision of a nurse practitioner trained in basic and advanced life support.
rationale_note: IC with PAD, face-to-face referral with risk-factor counseling; program meets all components.

service: Supervised exercise therapy (SET) for symptomatic PAD
